Implementation approach: To implement the 'mrk_browser', we will leverage Rust's modularity to create a hybrid GUI and TUI application. The core functionality will be divided into several modules, including a network library for handling HTTP requests using reqwest/tokio, a parser for sanitizing HTML tags and converting them to MDX format, and UI libraries for both graphical (using Tauri) and textual user interfaces (using Ratatui).
Program call flow:
sequenceDiagram
    participant M as MRKBrowser
    participant GH as GUIHandler
    participant BH as Browser
    participant T as TUIHandler
    participant R as Reader
    M->>M: run()
    M->>GH: display_content(content)
    GH->>BH: navigate(url)
    BH-->>GH: return tab with content
    GH->>GH: update_address_bar(url)
    M->>T: render_content(content)
    T->>R: read()
    R-->>T: return rendered content
